review_title: Surgical methods for first trimester termination of pregnancy
screening_criteria: Randomised controlled trials comparing different surgical methods for first trimester abortion were eligible.
gold_label_policy_description: dataset labels 1.0 and 0.5 count as INCLUDE; 0.0 counts as EXCLUDE

studies.study_title: Early complication after induced first‐trimaster abortion
studies.predicted_reason: Not a randomized controlled trial; a retrospective analysis of consecutive abortion cases without comparison of different surgical methods.

studies.study_title: Manual vacuum aspiration, a safe and effective alternative in early pregnancy termination
studies.predicted_reason: RCT randomizing women to manual vacuum aspiration (MVA) vs conventional electric vacuum aspiration, directly comparing two surgical methods for first trimester abortion.

studies.study_title: Induced termination of pregnancy before and after Roe v Wade. Trends in the mortality and morbidity of women
studies.predicted_reason: Not an RCT; a trends analysis comparing mortality pre/post Roe v Wade, not a comparison of different surgical methods.
RCT but compares prostaglandin cervical preparation vs placebo before vacuum aspiration, not different surgical methods. The surgical procedure was the same, so it does not compare surgical methods.

studies.study_title: A comparison of D&C and vacuum aspiration for performing first trimester abortion
studies.predicted_reason: RCT directly comparing dilatation and curettage (D&C) vs vacuum aspiration, two different surgical methods for first trimester abortion.

studies.study_title: Acceptability of manual versus electric aspiration for first trimester abortion: a randomised trial
studies.predicted_reason: RCT comparing manual vacuum aspiration vs electric vacuum aspiration, two different surgical methods; acceptability is a valid outcome.

studies.study_title: Similarities in women's perception and acceptability of manual vacuum aspiration and electric vacuum aspiration for first trimester abortion.
studies.predicted_reason: RCT assigning women to MVA vs EVA for first trimester abortion; compares two surgical methods, with perception/acceptability as outcomes.

studies.study_title: Abortion by means of suction curettage compared to conventional metal curette
studies.predicted_reason: No mention of randomization; appears to be a non-randomized comparison of vacuum aspiration vs D&C in a small sample. Not an RCT.

studies.study_title: First trimester abortion by vacuum aspiration
studies.predicted_reason: RCT comparing metal vs flexible plastic cannulae for vacuum aspiration, a comparison of two different surgical instruments/methods.

studies.study_title: Comparison of pain and time of procedure with two first trimester abortion techniques performed by residents and faculty
studies.predicted_reason: RCT comparing manual vacuum aspirator vs electric vacuum curettage, two different surgical methods for first trimester abortion.
